content.text: You’re a creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan. Stripe and PayPal reject your applications. Gumroad holds your payouts for weeks. You need a digital store that doesn’t depend on platforms that lock you out. This guide deploys a sovereign commerce stack using NOWPayments, GitHub Pages, and Cloudflare Workers. You own the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform risk. Payments settle directly to your wallet in USDT, BTC, or ETH. Transaction fees under $0.10 on Tron or Solana. Instant product delivery. Full data ownership. By the end of this guide, your store will be live—without a single platform between you and your customers.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This stack is built on open infrastructure you control. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a flat 0.5% fee—no KYC, no buyer accounts. Files deliver instantly via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Orders store in Supabase or Google Sheets. No platform can shut you down. No payout delays. No currency conversion fees. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-software-without-stripe-account-8|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-23|The Real]]-behind-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-13|architecture]] is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and Ethiopia—markets where financial isolation is the norm. You’re not renting a store. You’re deploying infrastructure.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, secure a crypto wallet that supports USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. Set up a NOWPayments account—it takes five minutes. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages for simplicity or Cloudflare Pages for edge performance. Decide on order storage: Supabase for scalability or Google Sheets for ease. Prepare your product files. Write your sales copy. Gather your branding assets. This stack assumes you’re technically capable or willing to follow precise instructions. If not, purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for done-for-you deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Integrate NOWPayments into your checkout flow. Configure webhooks to trigger product delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate file delivery. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. Test the pipeline with a $1 USDT transaction on Tron—fees will be under $0.10. Verify the webhook fires correctly. Ensure the file delivers instantly. This pipeline eliminates manual order processing. Customers pay, receive their product, and you’re notified—all without your involvement.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction—cheaper than PayPal or Stripe.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Test the live checkout with a real transaction. Monitor the webhook logs. Confirm the payment settles in your wallet. Verify the customer receives the file. Once confirmed, promote your store. Share the link directly—no platform intermediaries. Customers pay in their preferred cryptocurrency. You receive USDT on Tron or Solana for minimal fees. This system is live 24/7, processing payments while you sleep.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With the stack live, scale by adding products to your catalog. Use Supabase to manage larger order volumes. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability if selling courses or subscriptions. Monitor transaction fees—switch to Solana if Tron fees rise. Convert crypto to local currency via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. Reinvest profits into the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for advanced blueprints and templates. This infrastructure grows with you. No platform limits. No revenue caps. Full ownership at every stage.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT payments on Tron or Solana arrive in your wallet within minutes—often faster than PayPal payouts. Network fees are under $0.10 per transaction on Tron and fractions of a cent on Solana. NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook to deliver your product instantly. No waiting for platform approvals. No currency conversion delays. Your customers pay in crypto, you receive USDT, and the product delivers automatically. This system bypasses payout delays entirely.
Solana fees average fractions of a cent—ideal for high-volume digital sales.

To deploy this stack faster, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and a NOWPayments integration guide. Instant download. Worth $348 separately. Use the kit to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign store. Includes step-by-step instructions for USDT payment setup, webhook configuration, and P2P conversion strategies for Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya. Everything you need to own your infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Secure a crypto wallet supporting USDT on Tron or Solana. Sign up for NOWPayments. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. Prepare product files and sales copy. Integrate NOWPayments into your checkout. Configure webhooks for instant product delivery. Test the pipeline with a $1 transaction. Deploy your storefront. Promote your live store link. Monitor transactions. Convert crypto to local currency via P2P exchanges. Scale by adding products and upgrading infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I convert Bitcoin to naira in Nigeria?

Use P2P exchanges like Binance, Patricia, or Yellow Card. Create a sell order for Bitcoin and receive naira directly into your bank account. Rates are market-driven, and transactions complete within minutes. Avoid local traders for larger amounts—they often charge higher premiums.
What if a customer’s payment doesn’t arrive?

NOWPayments provides real-time transaction status via webhooks. If a payment fails, the customer is redirected to retry. Ensure your webhook logs are monitored. For manual refunds, send crypto directly from your wallet—no platform involvement.
Can I use this stack for physical products?

This stack is optimized for digital products with instant delivery. For physical goods, integrate a shipping API into your Cloudflare Worker. Use Supabase to track orders and inventory. Customers still pay in crypto, but you manually fulfill the physical shipment.
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?

Crypto transactions are irreversible. Once payment confirms, the product delivers automatically. Fraud risk is minimal because buyers must send crypto from their own wallets. No chargebacks. No disputes. Full payment sovereignty.
What if Tron or Solana fees increase?

Monitor network fees using block explorers. If fees rise, switch to an alternative network like BSC or Polygon. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Your stack remains flexible—no platform locks you into a single network.
Own your infrastructure. No platforms. No payout delays. Full sovereignty.
